event.description: Repair CPU projection fit for eleven-feature Fourier and parity positions
event.proposal: Family: position representation. Current retained frontier is 1,672 parameters at 99.010000%, a +0.010000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 7 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0030, which removed the never-forwarded positional row and qualified at 2,128 parameters and 99.14%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0109, an infrastructure error with no official score because MPS does not implement torch.linalg.lstsq. This is the permitted repair of the identical 1,666-parameter candidate: the same eleven-feature matrix and retained positional target are solved on CPU and transferred back to the training device; architecture, fitted objective, and evaluation are unchanged. Hypothesis: fixed multiscale phase plus parity preserves smooth order and operand-pair alternation better than attempt-0108's failed unconstrained rank-3 codes. Repairing the exact unscored candidate is more informative than a smaller basis because eleven features are the largest eligible projection and isolate infrastructure from representational capacity. Token streams, attention, autoregressive logits, and generic decoding remain unchanged.
